source: Worked by hand from PLAN.md sections 4 and 5 by an agent at the user's instruction, before comparing with the code. The blocking structure was found by search and then every number below was traced by hand. A should still check each case independently.

blocking.description: Two-way links (the real model). The cheapest path S-C-A-T (cost 4) uses S>C and A>T, which every other path of the maximum flow needs, so the second push must detour S-A-C-E-T (cost 10) and the third finds nothing: 2 of 3 delivered while max flow is 3. The minimum cut {S,A}|{C,E,T} is L1 + L2 + L3 = 3.

path_limit.description: Healthy diamond, max_paths 1, F1 alone (15 Mbps): 10 on A-B-D, A-C-D still free.

util_cap.description: util_cap 0.9 on capacity 10 gives effective capacity floor(9.0) = 9.
